input.context: just lint is the local CI entrypoint. It must discover every non-lock yml/yaml workflow and invoke shellcheck; generated gh-aw lock files retain their native compiler check.

excerpts.text:
ci: sync lint test secrets

lint:
    uv run --frozen ruff check .
    uv run --frozen ruff format --check .
    uv run --frozen pyright
    uv run --frozen zizmor --offline .github/workflows
    actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/source.yml .github/workflows/scoreboard.yml .github/workflows/dependabot-automerge.yml .github/workflows/consolidation.yml

defects.claim: The explicit actionlint file list omits newly added non-lock workflows, allowing invalid workflow or shell syntax to escape lint.
